units.source_text: 艺伎这样恶作剧，是下了很大决心的。

en.t: For the geisha to play such a prank, she must have made a very firm decision.

units.source_text: 对艺伎来说，这是一瞬间的事，也许没有什么意义。

en.t: For the geisha, it was something that happened in an instant, and perhaps it meant very little.

units.source_text: 太吉郎不是讨厌这年轻的艺伎，也不认为这是卑劣的行为。

en.t: Taikichiro did not dislike the young geisha, nor did he think this was a contemptible act.
